item.title: Live Jazz Tuesday: Syzygy Trio ∴ Boyd, Sanders & Hall — Tue Aug 18, 7:00 PM — Little Jumbo
item.description: A syzygy is the moment three celestial bodies fall into a single line. It is not a permanent condition. Sun, earth, and moon spend most of their existence scattered across the ecliptic, and then for a few hours the geometry snaps shut and something happens: an eclipse, a spring tide, a shadow crossing a face. Then it passes. Syzygy Trio is built on that principle. Three players, three orbits, and a music that exists only in the intervals when they line up. Jay Sanders anchors the low end on bass and moves to guitar and Erae Touch, a pressure-sensitive control surface that reads position, force, and the smallest lateral drift of a fingertip. It responds less like a keyboard than like a membrane, which means the synthesizer parts breathe and bend the way a bowed instrument does. Will Boyd plays saxophone and EWI, feeding both through an effects chain that can leave a tenor unaccompanied and naked or scatter it into a chorus of itself. item.title: Restorative Yoga & Didgeridoo Sound Healing in the Park — Fri Aug 21, 9:00 AM
item.description:
Awakening Asheville Stretch, breathe, and unwind beneath the trees.
Join us for a deeply restorative outdoor yoga experience designed to help you slow down, release tension, and reconnect with yourself. This gentle practice is accessible to most bodies and experience levels, offering plenty of space to relax, restore, and simply be.
This gathering is made especially unique by the presence of Wolfgang of the [Luminous Now](https://theluminousnow.com/), who will be sharing the grounding sounds of the didgeridoo throughout the practice. Its deep, ancient vibrations create a powerful sense of connection and calm, inviting the body into profound relaxation. For those who wish, individual sound healing with the didgeridoo will also be available.
We'll gather on a platform in the park, surrounded by the beauty of nature and the warmth of our welcoming yoga community. Cool morning air, birdsong, gentle movement, and immersive sound combine to create a truly nourishing start to the day.

item.title: Shut Up & Write - South Asheville — Sun Sep 6, 10:00 AM
item.description:
Shut Up & Write!® Western North Carolina Coworking for writers in your area! Join us for some focused writing time. All writers and all experience levels are welcome and don’t worry, no one will see what you've written. This session is about getting your writing done and meeting other writers in your area.
Please arrive a few minutes early to say hello to everyone, grab a drink, and get your writing tools ready. Once everyone’s arrived, I will lead quick introductions and then set the timer for our quiet and focused writing session.
Afterward, we’ll have time to chat and get to know each other. We often talk about our successes and challenges as writers. If you don’t have time to stick around, no worries!
A note about the format We don’t host critiques or readings. These events are a safe space for writers of all skill levels and genres to work on their craft, so no one will read or critique your writing.
For our full event schedule, visit https://shutupwrite.com

item.title: The Science of Happiness: The Four Noble Truths — Sun Sep 6, 10:30 AM
item.description:
Meditation in Asheville: Meditation and Modern Buddhism The Science of Happiness: The Four Noble Truths with Modern Buddhism Teacher Kadam Sharon Lovich
**Sundays 8/16-9/13, 10:30am-11:45am** Whether it’s everyday stress, sadness, or even anger, our suffering can be transformed into inner strength, love, and joy. The first step is understanding its source. In this series, we’ll explore Buddha’s teachings on the Four Noble Truths. The Four Noble Truths are the essence of Buddhist thought and gives us a clear, precise way to understand our life and how to move forward in it. Through teachings and meditation, we’ll discover that suffering comes not from external conditions, but from our own mind. Recognizing this opens the door to transforming our experience and uncovering a more lasting, genuine happiness.
